I am running the fuzz test `FuzzShapeIndexDecode` in the container environment and waiting for it to finish.
Running `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` across the repository in the container.
Added [`ShapeIndex.Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/shapeindex.go#L1628-L1648) and [`ShapeIndex.Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/shapeindex.go#L2144-L2159) on branch `shapeindex-encode-decode`:

- **Serialization & Spatial Index Preservation** ([shapeindex.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/shapeindex.go)):
  - [`Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/shapeindex.go#L1628-L1648) ensures pending updates are applied (`s.Build()`), writes the version header, `maxEdgesPerCell`, `nextID`, the sorted `(shapeID, shape)` entries for all built-in [`Shape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/shapeindex.go#L101-L169) types ([`Polygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/polygon.go#L52-L81), [`Polyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/polyline.go#L33), [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/point_vector.go#L24), [`LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/lax_polyline.go#L26-L28), [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/lax_polygon.go#L65-L75), [`Loop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/loop.go#L53-L81), [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/lax_loop.go#L28-L31), plus a generic fallback), the full spatial cell structure (`cells` and `cellMap` with each [`ShapeIndexCell`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/shapeindex.go#L218-L220) and [`clippedShape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/shapeindex.go#L180-L192)), and a 4-byte CRC32 checksum trailer.
  - [`Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/shapeindex.go#L2144-L2159) reconstructs shapes with their original IDs and populates `cells` and `cellMap` directly in `fresh` state so iteration and queries work immediately without calling [`Build`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/shapeindex.go#L801-L803).
  - Updated [`applyUpdatesInternal`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/shapeindex.go#L847-L890) and [`makeIndexCell`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/shapeindex.go#L1175-L1287) to iterate and bound shape IDs using `s.nextID` (rather than `len(s.shapes)`), and updated [`CrossingEdgeQuery.candidatesEdgeMap`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/crossing_edge_query.go#L204-L211) so indexes with removed shapes preserve valid cell references.
- **Shape Method Fixes**:
  - [`LaxLoop.ChainEdge`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/lax_loop.go#L64-L70): Fixed wrap-around index check (`j+1 != l.numVertices`).
  - [`LaxPolygon.ChainPosition`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/lax_polygon.go#L206-L221): Fixed returned chain ID (`nextLoop - 1`).
  - [`PointVector.ChainEdge`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/point_vector.go#L41-L43): Fixed degenerate edge endpoints (`(*p)[i], (*p)[i]`).
  - [`Polyline.decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/polyline.go#L357-L370): Took `*decoder` by pointer so decode errors propagate.
- **Malformed Input & Allocation Hardening**:
  - Validates version headers, boolean values, finite `float64` coordinates, shape/loop/vertex/cell counts, cell ID validity and ordering, shape ID ordering and existence, edge ID bounds, and CRC32 integrity, while capping initial slice/map capacities to prevent oversized allocations on malformed streams.
- **Tests** ([shapeindex_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-6p9fnhkb/s2/shapeindex_test.go#L577-L1398)):
  - Added unit and fuzz tests covering empty indexes, all built-in shape types, zero-edge shapes and mixed chain counts, encoding without explicit `Build`, shape ID preservation across removals, truncated/corrupted streams, and oversized allocation requests.
